purpose.en: Build the sides of your shoulders.

text.zh: 肘微屈固定，双臂向两侧抬到肩高
text.en: Keep a soft, fixed elbow and raise your arms out to shoulder height
Keep your shoulders down without shrugging.
Lower slowly without swinging your body.

commonErrors.en: Swinging the body to lift the weights.

cautions.zh: 从轻重量开始，出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Start with a light weight, and stop if you feel pain.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧夹痛时缩小幅度或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, reduce the range or switch to an easier version.
